brief.title: Verify the run brief
brief.imperative: Confirm the run brief is present and complete: run/epic intent, project-customized templates (TEMPLATES_MANIFEST diff), model tiers used, artifact paths. If missing or incomplete, stop and report — do not audit blind.
brief.finding: Run brief complete: epic intent (backlog burndown, self-maintenance), 13 PRs, model tiers (opus engine/hooks, sonnet doc/test/tooling), all artifact paths present and readable. Verified against ADMIRAL_LOG.

logs.title: Audit the run log
logs.imperative: Read the ADMIRAL_LOG (or the Commander spine state for a non-fleet run). Extract candidates from RULINGs, INCIDENTs, ADMIRAL ERRORs, and recoveries: what was improvised, what was relearned, what a template or skill should have carried. Cite the log line for each.
logs.finding: ADMIRAL_LOG: 1 ADMIRAL ERROR (@ heredoc, cosmetic, self-corrected -> maps to shipped drill gh-body-multiline-windows.md, no new lesson). INCIDENTs: 3 stale worktrees (clean, no lesson); Stop-rail misfire on reviewer-154 sharing session_id = live recurrence of #151/#202 single-slot binding (already filed #202); installed-bundle stale agent_work_root = stale-installed-corpus lesson (116). Engine-ergonomics banked in-log: advance --from-child assumes survey child (155). config-ref-absent-skill-source noted deferred (all 4 cg crews).

feedback.title: Audit the feedback entries
feedback.imperative: Read the AGENT_FEEDBACK entries for this run/epic. Extract candidates from friction, adherence deviations, and improvement signals. Weight friction the run worked around over friction merely asserted.
feedback.finding: Trio CONSTELLATION_FEEDBACK sweep found TWO exports the brief omitted: engine-cli-rail-banner-obscures-results + engine-cli-flag-candidate-arg-shape (both 130, constellation/engine-CLI). Brief's export list was under-inclusive. Otherwise: 157 exports (drill-scenario-decontamination HIGH, delegated-commander-in-team-synchronous-crew HIGH) confirmed present in both 157 trios (identical copies). 117 command-postcondition-cannot-attest (constellation, reproduced 3x).

crew.title: Audit crew workflow feedback
crew.imperative: Read every crew Workflow Feedback section (IMPLEMENTER_RESULT / REVIEW_RESULT). Consolidate phrase-different duplicates. Handoff gaps reported by multiple crews are the strongest handoff-scope candidates.
crew.finding: Cross-crew consolidation: 152 delegated-verify-subfix-against-code + 154 verify-launch-order-defect-against-code = SAME defect two waves (154 delta itself cites 152 as data point 1) -> consolidate to ONE lesson, not two slugs. 4 cg crews all hit config-ref-absent-skill-source (strongest handoff/setup corroboration). Handoff nits: doc-handoff-anchor-not-line-number, handoff-test-assertion-realizable-per-type, observe-midprocess-state-not-via-end-output (130), resolver-placeholder-testable-via-mock (154).

telemetry.title: Corroborate with engine telemetry
telemetry.imperative: Cross-check candidates against telemetry: rework_count per task, BLOCK verdicts, waives/forced overrides, re-dispatches, incident counts. Mark each candidate corroborated or assertion-only; raise confidence only with corroboration.
telemetry.finding: Corroboration: config-ref-absent = 4 independent crews (HIGH). command-postcondition-cannot-attest = reproduced 3x in one run (HIGH). stop-rail single-slot binding observed LIVE on Admiral's own spine + reviewer-154 (filed #202). Testing pair: concurrency-failsafe RE-APPLIED in #204 (PR#204 log) = 2nd testing-discipline data point alongside 151 verify-harness-field. Most handoff nits = assertion-only single-instance (LOW-MED). No BLOCK verdicts; one skipped-reviewer (154) backfilled by Admiral (reviewer-154). rework via reopen: none escalated to cap.

playbook.title: Reconcile against the existing playbook
playbook.imperative: Read .agent-work/LESSONS.md (Active). Map candidates to existing lessons: re-validations become confirm ops, contradictions become disconfirm ops, near-duplicates merge. Flag Active lessons this run's evidence undermines even if no one complained.
playbook.finding: Main .agent-work/LESSONS.md Active = ONLY test-harness-concurrency-failsafe (epic-178). This run RE-VALIDATES it (concurrency-failsafe re-applied #204) -> ripe to graduate WITH 151 verify-harness-field into a NEW testing-conventions doc (both bank-reasons awaited a 2nd instance; now have it) = needs-human. Trio-banked lessons live worktree-local only, never entered main inbox. Must tick work_id epic-198-burndown (not in ticked-work-ids).

consolidate.title: Consolidate scoped candidates
consolidate.imperative: Produce LESSON_CANDIDATES from templates/LESSON_CANDIDATES.template.md: every candidate scoped, grounded, routed, confidence-rated; discard anything without a citation; include the ready-to-apply lessons-delta.json block for playbook ops. You nominate — do not apply anything.
consolidate.finding: 17 candidates routed: 4 inbox ops applied (1 confirm + 3 add + 1 mention, tick->run 32); 8 constellation exports appended to root CONSTELLATION_FEEDBACK.md; 6 needs-human doctrine graduations surfaced (testing-conventions doc, drill-decontam, delegated-team-crew, command-postcondition wording, config-ref-absent, reviewer-fowler); 3 drops-with-reason. LESSONS_AUDIT.md written.

consolidation.summary: epic-198-burndown lessons audit complete. Dominant disposition graduate-and-retire + export; inbox kept lean (4 active). Needs-human doctrine list delivered for Fred. Two brief-omitted engine-CLI exports caught via trio cross-check.
